english.title: Cause / permit failure to install a CCTV system in relation to slaughterhouses
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

**(..SPECIFY NAME..), the business operator of a slaughterhouse, namely **(..SPECIFY SLAUGHTERHOUSE..), to fail to ensure that a CCTV system was installed that provided a complete and clear image of killing and related operations in all areas of the slaughterhouse where live animals were present
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 3(1), 9(1)(a) and 12 of the Mandatory Use of Closed Circuit Television in Slaughterhouses (England) Regulations 2018.
